title: The +211% that wasn't
headline: The +211% that wasn't.
dek: On Oct 2, TCGplayer's market price for Raikou (Shiny) from Call of Legends jumped 210.7% in a day, to $698.99. Not one checked sale stood behind it. In our first three days of daily movers, half the moves looked like that.
why_now: The board started showing what moved since yesterday on Oct 3. Its first three lists (prices from Oct 2 to Oct 4) held 30 moves. None had a checked sale behind it, and 15 were bigger than 40%.
risk: Some of these may be real: a card that rarely trades can reprice on one honest sale. Unconfirmed means nobody has checked yet, not that the sale was fake.
what_to_watch: From this week, a one-day move with no checked sale shows on the board only if it is 40% or less and the lowest listing moved the same way. Watch how many make the cut.
source: TCGplayer market prices via tcgcsv.com, from the board's daily movers (Oct 3 to 5, 2026)

flags.text: TCGplayer's market price averages recent sales, so on a card that rarely sells, one sale can swing it by half or more overnight. None of these 15 moves had a sale checked by Mission Control behind it, so each one stays unconfirmed until a checked sale speaks to it.
